Accessibility

This website should be usable by everyone, including people who use a keyboard, a screen reader, magnification or other assistive technology.

What has been done

  • Pages are built as plain HTML with headings, landmarks and labelled form fields, so their content works without JavaScript.
  • Every page can be used with a keyboard alone. A "Skip to content" link comes first, and the element in focus is outlined.
  • Text and controls are checked for colour contrast in both the light and dark colour schemes.
  • Animation is turned off when your device asks for reduced motion.
  • English pages are marked as English, and Farsi pages as Farsi with right-to-left layout, so screen readers use the right voice.

How it's checked

Each release is tested with automated checks for labels, landmarks, colour contrast, keyboard access and visible focus, at desktop and phone widths, in light and dark mode.

Automated testing doesn't find every barrier. The site hasn't had an independent audit or testing by people who use assistive technology, so it doesn't claim to fully meet any accessibility standard.

Known limitations

  • The neighbourhood drawings are decorative or summarised in nearby text; they don't describe every detail of each building.
  • The calculators give estimates. If you can't use them, ask and Ali will work out the numbers with you.

Ask for another format, or report a problem

If something on this site is hard to use, or you'd like information in another format, call or text (647) 779-7919 or email ali@alibayatrealty.com. Please say which page and what went wrong. Ali will reply and provide the information in a format that works for you.

Statement last reviewed November 11, 2026.
